boundaries: Product hide revokes input permission; re-enable requires an explicit mode action.
System Back focus and permission behavior depends on device and system; S44 is conditional example, not a universal guarantee.
Illustrated keyboard is not a proof of Android IME display, input delivery, terminal rendering or PTY behavior.
Prior objects were compared only on listed fields; styles and every property were not exhaustively compared.
S03 preexisting hide hit rectangle is 64 × 42 design units; touch accessibility remains device validation.
